_meta.description: Heart event #2 for npc_kiery: The Collection

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Jack, can I show you something? My secret collection.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Kiery opens a chest filled with salvaged Old World textiles]

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: This was a ball gown. Pre-war. Silk that doesn't exist anymore.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: And this — a military uniform. Still has the rank insignia.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Each one was someone's life. Someone's story. I gave them new purpose.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Nobody's ever said that before. Memory through fabric.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: That's exactly what it is. Thank you for understanding.
